signedOutText: Sign in with Google to see which association invited you and join. It takes half a minute.
invalidBannerText: An admin has probably created a new link. Ask the person who invited you to send the new one.
memberText: As a member you can start meetings and get access to the association's meeting documents.

whoami.title: Which one is you?
whoami.text: Tap your name. Your tasks then find their way to you, and the notes know who's speaking.
whoami.listLabel: Names in {org} without an account yet
whoami.noneText: Everyone on the list already has an account. Type your name and we'll add you.
whoami.notListedText: Type your name and we'll add you to the list.
whoami.nameHint: First and last name, as it should appear in the minutes.
whoami.roleHint: For example Treasurer or Board member.

error.upptagen: Someone else already has that name. Pick another one, or ask an admin for help.
error.redan: You're already linked to a name here. An admin can change it under Settings.
error.namn: Type your name using letters, four words at most.
error.roll: Keep the role to four words at most, for example Treasurer.
error.fel: That didn't work just now. Try again.

welcome.title: Welcome to {org}!
welcome.tasks: Your tasks from meetings show up under <link>Home</link>.
welcome.docs: Meeting notes are shared with your Google account and live under the Meetings tab.
